title: Extension by zero to ℝ^P of an integer multiplicity current vanishing off a compact subset of its open domain (parent step 3(a)–(b))
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let K ⊆ U be compact, and let A ∈ 𝒟_d(U) be integer multiplicity and vanish off K. Then there is an integer multiplicity current Y ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) (domain univ) such that Y⌞U = A (Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = A, i.e. Y(ιω) = A(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U)), Y vanishes off K (Y(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(ℝ^P) whose tsupport is disjoint from K), and M(Y) ≤ M(A) in [0, ∞]. Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For D ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(D) = TestFormOn D d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in D) and 𝒟_d(D) = GeometricCurrentOn D d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x; M(X) = X.mass = M_D(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in D is the contract structure IMRep D d; R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵈ(x); R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D); μ_R = R.measure = (Hᵈ⌞M).withDensity θ; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep in D represents it. For V ⊆ D, ι = testFormOnInclusion regards ω ∈ 𝒟^d(V) as an element of 𝒟^d(D) with the same underlying form, and X⌞V = X.restrictDomain (V ⊆ D) ∈ 𝒟_d(V) is given by X⌞V(ω) = X(ιω). X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every test form ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) K → A ω = 0) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = A ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) K → Y ω = 0) ∧ Y.mass ≤ A.mass
